---
title: "Ik Mazloom Kay Tun Pay Baarish Teero Ki"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Noha"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

Ik mazloom kay tun pay baarish teero ki

dasht ki garmi chaaoon thee hai, dasht ki garmee chaaoon thee shamsheero ki

Asghar aaja lori sunaao, bin Akber kay chain na paaoo

sughra khair duaain karti bhaiyya ki

deen ki khaatir sir kutwaayaa, nayzaay per quraan sunaaya

laaj rakee Shabbir nay laa ilaha ki

Abid kyun hain tauq sambhaalee, aankhoon say kyun khoon hai jaari

roeye zaar-o-zaar lari zanjeero ki

punjaten ki jaagir ki waaris, bay parda tatheer ki waaris

sir nungay baazaaro main hain bint-e-Ali

Bhai ki laash pay ro kar boli, khoon kay aansoo Zahra jaaee

bin chadar hai maut teri hamsheera ki

    \"دین کی خاطر سر کٹوایا، نیزے پر قرآن سنایا\",
    \"لاج رکھی شبیر نے لا الٰہ کی\",
    \"عابد کیوں ہیں طوق سنبھالے، آنکھوں سے کیوں خون ہے جاری\",
    \"روئے زار و زار لڑی زنجیروں کی\",
    \"پنجتن کی جاگیر کی وارث، بے پردہ تطہیر کی وارث\",
    \"سر ننگے بازاروں میں ہیں بنتِ علی\",
    \"بھائی کی لاش پہ رو کر بولی، خون کے آنسو زہرا جائی\",
    \"بن چادر ہے موت تیری ہمشیرہ کی\",
]
roman[8] = roman[8].replace(\"Tatheer\", \"tatheer\")

def blocks(lines, numerals):
    return [lines[:2]] + [[number, *lines[i:i+2]] for number, i in zip(numerals, range(2, len(lines), 2), strict=True)]
roman_block = \"\\n  \\n\".join(\"\\n\".join(\"  \" + line for line in block) for block in blocks(roman, \"12345\")).replace(\"\\n  \\n\", \"\\n\\n\")
source_body = \"\\n\\n\".join(\"\\n\".join(block) for block in blocks(source, \"۱۲۳۴۵\"))
p.write_text(f\"---{meta}romanLyrics: |-\\n{roman_block}\\n---\\n\\n{source_body}\\n\")

Reconstructed all 12 Urdu verses in the [selected lyric](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/1/workspaces/efd5e7fe6f7c46de95440c204d3d9f62/src/data/lyrics/ik-mazloom-kay-tun-pay-baarish-teero-ki-nw-a2e1a3811408.md). Preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics` and verified that both versions have a two-verse opening followed by five numbered couplets.

Set the Urdu title and RTL direction, retained the Roman alternate title, and removed `noUrdu`. I read the ambiguous `sambhaalee` as `سنبھالے` and preserved the unusual `th ee hai` wording as `تھی ہے`.
